note: Seed demos plus verified public fails appended 2026-11-01, 2026-11-03, 2026-11-04, 2026-11-05, 2026-11-06, 2026-11-09, 2026-11-10, 2026-11-11, and 2026-11-12 (label verify over 24h, Stocky read-only window). demo=false = sourced.

fails.titleZh: 买面单卡在「账户核验」，24 小时承诺拖过百小时
fails.titleEn: Label buying stuck on account verification well past 24 hours
fails.failZh: 2026-11-11，两名商家同一天在 Shopify Community 报告：买面单时出现 “Shipping labels are temporarily unavailable. We are verifying your account before you can purchase shipping labels. This process may take up to 24 hours.” 其中一人称已超过 100 小时、自周四起就无法出单，已付款订单积压；多次联系客服只有安抚，没有核验结果或时限。另一人一周前刚把旧站迁到 Shopify，同一条文案已卡 2 天，聊天客服称已转内部团队，但 “no definite timeline”。官方故障排除文档写明：账户或身份核验期间会暂停购买面单，通常 24 小时内完成，超时应联系支持。两例实际等待都远超该时间，Shopify Shipping 折扣面单不可用，订单发不出去。
fails.failEn: On 2026-11-11, two merchants posted on the Shopify Community that buying a label showed: “Shipping labels are temporarily unavailable. We are verifying your account before you can purchase shipping labels. This process may take up to 24 hours.” One said the hold had already lasted more than 100 hours, since the previous Thursday, with paid orders sitting unfulfilled; repeated Support contacts produced empathy but no review outcome or timeline. The other had migrated a site to Shopify a week earlier and had been stuck on the same message for two days; chat said the request was sent to an internal team with “no definite timeline.” Shopify’s troubleshooting docs say label purchases are paused during an account or identity check and usually finish within 24 hours, after which you should contact Support. In both reports the wait far exceeded that window, so discounted Shopify Shipping labels could not be bought and orders could not go out.
fails.fixZh: 不要只盯着横幅空等。官方文档写明超过 24 小时应联系支持：在同一张工单里要求升级到能处理「面单账户核验」的团队，写明已付款未发货订单和已等待时长，不要另开新单。同时用 USPS、UPS、FedEx 或第三方打单服务直接买面单，在 Shopify 里完成履约并填入运单号，顾客仍能收到物流更新（社区建议这条，受影响商家也确认可行，只是通常比 Shopify Shipping 更贵）。并检查 Settings → Locations 发货地址是真实街道地址而非 PO Box，店主邮箱和垃圾箱有没有身份核验邮件，以及 Settings → Billing 是否有未付的面单余额（官方写明欠费会拦住继续买面单）。若还想等 Shopify Shipping 恢复后再买官方面单，不要先把订单标成已发货，否则原生「购买运费标签」入口会消失。
fails.fixEn: Don’t wait on the banner. Shopify’s docs say to contact Support after 24 hours: in the same ticket, ask for an escalation to the team that handles shipping-label account verification, include the paid unfulfilled orders and the elapsed time, and do not open a new ticket. Meanwhile buy labels directly from USPS, UPS, FedEx, or a third-party label service, fulfill the order in Shopify, and paste in the tracking number so the buyer still gets updates. Community replies recommended this, and an affected merchant confirmed it works, though it is often more expensive than Shopify Shipping. Also check that Settings → Locations uses a real street address rather than a PO Box, that the store-owner inbox and spam folder have no pending identity-verification email, and that Settings → Billing has no outstanding shipping-label balance—Shopify documents that an unpaid balance blocks new labels. If you still want to buy official Shopify Shipping labels once verification clears, do not mark those orders fulfilled first, or the native Buy shipping label action disappears.

fails.titleZh: Stocky 只读导出窗口临近关闭，关键数据并不在文件里
fails.titleEn: Stocky’s read-only export window is closing—and some data was never exportable
fails.failZh: Stocky 已于 2026-08-31 关停（2 月 2 日已从应用商店下架，无法重装）。官方迁移说明写明：关停后至少还有 90 天只读访问用于导出数据，按此推算窗口大约落在 11 月底；历史采购单不能导入 Shopify，供应商也无法从 Stocky 导出。社区商家在窗口临近时核对文件后发现：采购单导出是唯一能把商品、供应商、价格和日期绑在一起的文件；供应商联系方式、付款条款、MOQ 提醒、备注、按供应商或商品覆盖的交期、以及预期到货日，都不在任何导出里。若只导出产品、或等到窗口关闭后再想补导，这些记录可能再也拿不回来。官方还写 Stocky API 已在 8 月 31 日停止。
fails.failEn: Stocky shut down on 2026-08-31 (it was delisted from the App Store on February 2, so it cannot be reinstalled). Shopify’s migration guide says merchants keep read-only access to export data for at least 90 days after that date, which lands around late November. It also states that historical Stocky purchase orders cannot be imported into Shopify, and that suppliers cannot be exported from Stocky. Merchants checking their files before the window closes reported that the purchase-order export is the only file that ties a product to a supplier, a price, and a date. Supplier contacts, payment terms, MOQ reminders, notes, per-supplier or per-product lead-time overrides, and expected delivery dates were missing from every export they pulled. Exporting only products, or waiting until the window closes, can mean those records are gone. Shopify also says Stocky APIs stopped on August 31.
fails.fixZh: 只读窗口还开着时立刻导出并留存：全部已完成采购单报告（CSV）、盘点历史、历史成本，以及调拨记录。先保留原始文件，另存副本再整理，避免表格软件把长变体 ID 或日期弄乱。用采购单导出重建供应商名单（每行带有供应商名），同时打开仍可访问的 Stocky 供应商页，手工抄下邮箱、电话、地址、付款条款、MOQ、备注、交期覆盖和未完成采购单的预期到货日。仍未完成的采购单，按剩余数量在 Shopify 或替代工具里重建；不要假设导入后仍是「进行中的订单」。历史采购单无法导入 Shopify，导出文件就是以后的审计底稿。
fails.fixEn: Export now, while read-only access remains: all completed purchase-order reports as CSVs, stocktake history, historical cost data, and transfers. Keep the original files untouched and clean a working copy—spreadsheet tools can mangle long variant IDs or dates. Rebuild the supplier list from the purchase-order export (each line names the supplier), and while Stocky still opens, manually copy supplier emails, phone numbers, addresses, payment terms, MOQs, notes, lead-time overrides, and expected dates on open orders. Recreate any still-open purchase orders in Shopify or a replacement app for remaining quantities only; an import generally preserves history, not live open orders. Historical POs cannot be imported into Shopify, so the exports are the audit copy you will keep.

fails.titleZh: 打款币种从克朗改英镑后，退款卡在「待处理」
fails.titleEn: DKK→GBP payout switch leaves refunds stuck pending
fails.failZh: 一家丹麦店铺以英镑销售，2026-08-07 把 Shopify Payments 打款币种从丹麦克朗（DKK）改为英镑（GBP）。此后退款反复失败：先是克朗订单无法动用英镑余额，后来连英镑订单也不能退。客服曾在 10 月把负余额按 2% 手续费折成英镑，并称已修好，数周后又复发。客服改口说克朗余额不足，尽管账户里约有 55,000 英镑。到 11 月初，约 90 单、随后超过 100 单退款停在待处理，顾客投诉与拒付上升。工单 69705089 一度无人回复。欧洲非欧元银行账户的负余额通常靠后续销售填平，Shopify 不会直接扣银行；若新销售全是英镑，克朗缺口可能一直补不上。文档还写明：任一余额仍为负时，后面的退款不论币种都排在同一队列。
fails.failEn: A Denmark-based store selling in GBP changed its Shopify Payments payout currency from DKK to GBP on 2026-08-07. Refunds then failed repeatedly: first DKK orders could not use the GBP balance, later GBP orders could not be refunded either. Support converted negative DKK/EUR balances to GBP in October (2% fee) and said it was fixed; within weeks it returned. Support then said refunds were held for insufficient DKK funds, even though the account held about £55,000 in GBP. By early November about 90 orders, then more than 100, sat in pending refunds, with customer complaints and chargebacks. Ticket 69705089 went unanswered for a stretch. For European accounts with a non-euro bank, Shopify’s refund docs say negative balances are cleared by future sales—not by debiting the bank—so a leftover DKK deficit may never fill if new sales are all GBP. The same docs say pending refunds only run, in creation order, after the negative balance is cleared, which is why GBP refunds queued too.
fails.fixZh: 先导出受影响订单与退款流水，核对原支付币种、退款状态和各币种余额，切勿在待处理未结束时重复点退款。打开订单列表横幅，看「还款 / Make a payment」合计（负余额加待处理退款）。还款前务必让客服书面确认：这笔钱会冲哪一个币种余额、以及付完后队列会按时间释放；若曾因账户已有英镑而被退回打款，先把这一点写进工单再操作。多出来的款项应在下一笔打款退回。审查期间尽快接入备用网关，避免在无法退款时继续只走 Shopify Payments。
fails.fixEn: Export the affected orders and refund transactions and check original payment currency, refund status, and each currency balance; do not click refund again while earlier attempts are still pending. On the Orders page, look for the banner with a Make a payment total (negative balance plus pending refunds). Before paying, get Support to confirm in writing which balance that payment will clear and that it will release the queue—especially if a previous banner payment was returned because a large GBP balance was already on the account. Any overpayment should come back in the next payout. Stand up a backup payment provider so you are not taking new Shopify Payments orders you cannot refund.

fails.titleZh: 工单全被关闭、按钮点不了，货款被扣六个星期
fails.titleEn: Closed tickets and dead buttons hold payouts for six weeks
fails.failZh: 一名商家自 2026-09-21 起 Shopify Payments 打款被冻结，到 10 月中已超 12,000 欧元，后来升至约 14,600 欧元。四个星期内开了 9 张工单，全部在问题未解决时被关闭，无法再回复；邮件给法务也被转回这些已关闭工单。后台 Payments 有蓝色「核实企业信息 · 等待处理」横幅，Versements（打款）页有橙色「需要操作」，却都点不进去。10 月 2 日系统称银行拒收一笔打款，银行书面确认账户无问题，点「我已解决银行问题」后也毫无变化。大约第 30 天才收到核验邮件，要求提供带增值税号与公司全称的官方文件，以及实益所有人（UBO，法国相当于 RBE）声明；邮件里的文件链接无效，又拖了一周。补齐材料后几天货款到账，前后共扣约六个星期。商家同期装了 Mollie，并在 X 点名 @ShopifySupport。另一名商家 11 月 4 日称仍卡在类似状态。
fails.failEn: A merchant’s Shopify Payments payouts were blocked from 2026-09-21. By mid-October more than €12,000 was held, later about €14,600. In four weeks they opened nine Support tickets; each was closed while the problem was still open, so they could not reply, and legal email was sent back to those same closed tickets. In admin, a blue “verify business information · pending resolution” banner on Payments and an orange “Action required” button on Payouts were both not clickable. On October 2 the system said the bank had refused a payout; the bank confirmed in writing that the account was fine, and clicking “I have resolved my bank issue” did nothing. An email from the verification team arrived only on about day 30, asking for an official document with the VAT number and full company name, plus a UBO (beneficial-owner) declaration. The document link in that email was invalid, adding another week. After the paperwork was completed, the held funds arrived within days—about six weeks in total. The merchant had also installed Mollie and posted on X tagging @ShopifySupport. Another merchant reported a similar stall on November 4.
fails.fixZh: 别在已关闭工单里空等：查店主邮箱和垃圾箱，直接回复 Payments / 核验团队的来信（那才到经办人）。后台若有「需要操作」却点不开，书面要求发可用的补件链接，并准备增值税号+公司全称的官方文件与 UBO/RBE 声明，不要等按钮自己好。记下每张工单与邮件的日期，勿把店铺权限交给私信「帮忙」的人。审查一开始就启用 Mollie、PayPal 等备用网关，不要把现金流单押在 Shopify Payments。
fails.fixEn: Don’t wait inside closed tickets: check the store-owner inbox and spam, and reply to mail from the Payments / verification team—that is what reaches the people on the case. If an “Action required” control is not clickable, ask in writing for a working document link, and have an official VAT-number + legal-name document and a UBO declaration ready instead of waiting for the button to work. Keep a dated log of every ticket and email, and never hand store access to someone offering help in a private message. Enable a backup gateway such as Mollie or PayPal as soon as a review starts; don’t single-home cash flow on Shopify Payments.

fails.titleZh: AI 代客下单绕过费用 App，危化等强制附加费没加上
fails.titleEn: Agentic checkout skips fee apps and drops mandatory surcharges
fails.failZh: 一名多供应商 B2B 商家销售含危化、温控等必须加收附加费的商品。经由 ChatGPT、Google 等 AI 购物代理下的订单会绕过常规购物车与结账，购物车层费用 App（如 Magical Fees）加不上危化费、温控运费、供应商/SKU 与关税附加费，每单都在亏。商家已关闭加速结账，又试过结账层的 VOL Extra Fees & Surcharges，开发者工作数周后确认这是平台限制、App 修不了。客服给出的可靠方案是升到 Shopify Plus，对尚在起步的商家不现实。Shop Pay 也曾出现类似绕过，只好关掉大部分快捷结账。
fails.failEn: A multi-vendor B2B merchant selling hazmat and temperature-controlled goods saw orders placed through AI shopping agents such as ChatGPT and Google skip the normal cart and checkout. Cart-level fee apps (including Magical Fees) never applied required hazmat, temperature-control, vendor, SKU, and tariff surcharges, so each affected order lost money. The merchant disabled accelerated checkout, then tried a checkout-level app (VOL Extra Fees & Surcharges); after weeks of work the app’s developers said this was a Shopify platform limit they could not fix. Support’s reliable path was upgrading to Shopify Plus, which was not realistic for a new business. Shop Pay had already forced a similar retreat: most quick-checkout options had to be turned off.
fails.fixZh: 不一定要升 Plus。打开销售渠道里的 Agentic（或对应 AI 渠道），关闭「直接结账 / 由 Shopify 代管」，保留目录可见：代理仍能推荐商品，顾客必须点回官网，费用 App 才会跑。必须让代理也能下单时，把强制附加费写进原生运费：Settings→Shipping and delivery，为危化/温控商品建独立运费配置，把附加费加进费率名称与价格（例如「标准运费 + 强制危化费」）。原生运费引擎走服务端，API/Agentic 结账绕不开。用购物车或浏览器里存费的 App 更易被跳过，优先用结账阶段、服务端逻辑，并自己走一单 AI 下单验收。
fails.fixEn: You don’t need Plus to close the gap. In Sales channels → Agentic (or the matching AI channel), turn off Direct Checkout / “Allow Shopify to manage for me” and leave Catalog access on: agents can still recommend products, but the buyer has to check out on your site so fee apps can run. If agents must be able to complete the order, bake mandatory surcharges into native shipping: under Settings → Shipping and delivery, create a profile for hazmat / temperature-controlled items and add the fee into the rate name and price (for example, “Standard shipping + mandatory hazmat fee”). Shopify’s native shipping engine is server-side, so API/agentic checkouts cannot skip it. Apps that store fees in the cart or the browser are easier to bypass; prefer checkout-stage, server-side logic, and place a test order through an agent before you rely on the path.

fails.titleZh: 账户「无需操作」审查，打款却被静默暂停
fails.titleEn: “No action required” review silently pauses payouts
fails.failZh: 2026-11-04，一家加拿大零售商（两家实体店加独立站）发现 Shopify Payments 打款突然被暂停。后台写账户审查中、最多约一周，且「目前无需操作」。电话与在线客服都称账户状态正常、暂不要求补件，工单已标优先，但只有 Payments 团队能发邮件、无法转接、也无明确解决时限。顾客仍可付款，货款却到不了银行，已排期的 11 月 4–5 日打款去向不明，影响供货与日常开支。
fails.failEn: On 2026-11-04 a Canadian retailer with two physical stores plus an online shop found Shopify Payments payouts suddenly paused. Admin said the account was under review for up to a week and that no action was required. Live chat and phone support said the account was in good standing, no documents were needed, and the case was escalated as priority—but only the Payments team can email, Support cannot transfer the call, and there was no firm resolution date. Stores could still take payment, yet funds would not reach the bank; payouts already scheduled for November 4–5 were in limbo, threatening supplier payments and daily costs.
fails.fixZh: 勿把「无需操作」当成打款仍在走：打开 Finance→Payouts 核对哪些打款显示暂停并截图保存；查店主邮箱及垃圾箱（Payments 团队来信常与客服不同）。书面要求记下工单号、是否需补件与时限，勿另开第二张工单以免排队后移。审查期间启用 PayPal/Stripe 等备用网关，并预留一周以上现金流，勿单押 Shopify Payments。
fails.fixEn: Don’t treat “no action required” as proof payouts are moving: open Finance → Payouts, note which payouts are on hold, and save screenshots. Check the account-owner inbox and spam—Payments-team mail often comes from a different address than Support chat. Ask Support to put the case number, any requirements, and the timeline in writing; avoid opening a second ticket, which can push the review back. Stand up a backup gateway (PayPal/Stripe, etc.) and keep more than a week of cash buffer; don’t single-home on Shopify Payments.

fails.titleZh: Shopify 接管 DHL 德国轨迹后，原生签收邮件被 App 写回跳过
fails.titleEn: DHL Germany native tracking + ParcelPanel skips Delivered emails
fails.failZh: 商家发现顾客不再收到 Shopify 原生的「已送达」邮件。客服解释：2026 年 10 月起 Shopify 开始直接追踪 DHL Germany 包裹；同时 ParcelPanel 仍会回写物流状态，且通知开关为关，于是原生 Delivered 邮件被跳过。包裹其实已签收，平台签收通知却静默消失。
fails.failEn: A merchant noticed customers stopped receiving Shopify’s native Delivered email. Support said Shopify began tracking DHL Germany shipments directly in October 2026, while ParcelPanel was still writing tracking status back to Shopify with notifications turned off—so the native Delivered email was skipped. Parcels were delivered, but the platform delivery notice never went out.
fails.fixZh: 在 ParcelPanel 关闭「把物流状态写回 Shopify 通知」一类选项，让 Shopify 按原生 DHL Germany 轨迹自己触发 Delivered 邮件；发一单德国 DHL 实测，并核对 Settings→Notifications 里 Delivered 模板仍启用。若坚持用 App 发信，改为只走 App 通知，避免两边同时写状态。
fails.fixEn: In ParcelPanel, turn off the setting that writes tracking status back to Shopify notifications so Shopify can fire its own Delivered email from native DHL Germany tracking events; send a test DHL Germany shipment and confirm the Delivered template is still enabled under Settings → Notifications. If you prefer the app’s emails, send only from the app and don’t let both systems write status.

fails.titleZh: API 2026-10 后新装运费 App，结账静默无费率
fails.titleEn: API 2026-10: new shipping apps silently return no rates
fails.failZh: Admin API 2026-10 起，创建 carrier service 不再自动加入店铺的 General 运费配置及其分区。新装、重装或迁移实时运费 App（若已切到该版本）后，结账可能直接没有运费可选，且不报错。重装后分区里旧的「使用承运商或 App 计算运费」行看起来还在，却可能指向已失效的 carrier-service ID；App 超时同样只表现为无费率。社区反馈因此丢掉订单，Q4 放量前不易察觉。
fails.failEn: As of Admin API version 2026-10, creating a carrier service no longer adds it to the shop’s General shipping profile or its zones. Stores that install, reinstall, or migrate a live-rate shipping app on that API version can reach checkout with no rates and no error. After a reinstall, a zone’s “Use carrier or app to calculate rates” line can still look correct while pointing at an obsolete carrier-service ID; app timeouts also fail closed as “no rate.” A community report warned of lost orders because the failure is silent—easy to miss before Q4 volume.
fails.fixZh: 打开 Settings→Shipping and delivery，确认每个分区都有「使用承运商或 App 计算运费」且选中当前 App；刚重装的话，删掉旧费率行再从下拉重新添加。核对商品是否在你刚改的配置（自定义配置不会读 General）。向各运费 App 确认其 API 版本及是否会自动挂到配置；对每个分区和独立配置里的商品测一单结账后再开广告。
fails.fixEn: In Settings → Shipping and delivery, open the profile that holds your products and confirm each zone has a “Use carrier or app to calculate rates” entry pointing at the current app. After a reinstall, delete the old rate line and add it again from the dropdown. Check that the SKUs sit in the profile you edited—custom profiles ignore General. Ask each live-rate app which API version it uses and whether it attaches rates to a profile; test-checkout every zone (and products in separate profiles) before turning ads back on.

fails.titleZh: 机器人防护误拦 Meta 内置浏览器
fails.titleEn: Bot protection blocks Meta in-app browsers
fails.failZh: 店主用自己的 Chrome 打开店铺，只看到空白页上的 local_rate_limited。Support 调边缘日志后称「机器人防护判定该会话为自动化流量，属预期行为」。五天内店面出现 1,688 次 429，大量归到 VPN/托管/数据中心/Meta 基础设施 IP。消费级杀毒（如 McAfee）会在公共 Wi-Fi 自动开 VPN；从 Facebook/Instagram 应用内点广告也会中招。一商家当月 Meta 花费 £3,531.72，Facebook 转化率从 5 月的 3.33% 掉到 0.78%。2026-08-17 Shopify 员工公开确认部分 Meta 应用内浏览器流量被误分类并在调查。拦截发生在分析脚本加载前，后台只见访客变少、没有报错。
fails.failEn: A merchant opened their own storefront in Chrome and got a blank page reading only local_rate_limited. Support pulled edge logs and called it expected bot-protection behavior. In five days the shop saw 1,688 storefront 429s, many attributed to VPNs, hosting, datacenters, or Meta infrastructure IPs. Consumer antivirus (e.g. McAfee) can auto-enable a VPN on public Wi-Fi; Facebook/Instagram in-app browsers that carry paid-social clicks were also hit. One merchant spent £3,531.72 on Meta that month while Facebook conversion rate fell from 3.33% in May to 0.78%. On 2026-08-17 Shopify staff publicly confirmed some Meta in-app browser traffic was being misclassified and was under investigation. Because the block happens before analytics load, dashboards show fewer visitors—not an error.
fails.fixZh: 用杀毒自带 VPN，并在 Facebook/Instagram 应用内点自己的广告实测（勿把链接粘到 Safari/Chrome）；对比广告点击与店铺会话，缺口突然拉大且无投放变更就要怀疑；把空白页/local_rate_limited/429 的 request ID 与 HAR 交给 Support；大促前不要只靠状态页或后台无报错判断店铺可达。
fails.fixEn: Reproduce with a consumer antivirus VPN and by tapping your own ads inside Facebook/Instagram (not a pasted link in Safari/Chrome); compare ad clicks vs store sessions—a sudden unexplained gap is the signal; send Support the request ID and HAR for any blank/local_rate_limited/429 page; don’t treat a quiet dashboard or green status page as proof the storefront is reachable before a sale.

fails.titleZh: 主题 View Transition 让 Meta 内置浏览器白屏
fails.titleEn: Theme view transitions blank Meta in-app browsers
fails.failZh: Drive、Atelier 3.5.1、Horizon 等主题在 Chrome/Brave 一切正常，但 Facebook/Instagram 应用内浏览器里，直达链接能打开，一点站内导航或「立即购买」整页变白。地址栏已变，锁屏再亮却能看到已加载的页面。根因是 base.css 里的 @view-transition { navigation: auto; }：Meta 的 WebView 启动了跨文档过渡却永不结束，页面停在未绘制状态。
fails.failEn: Stores on Drive, Atelier 3.5.1, or Horizon looked fine in Chrome and Brave, but inside Facebook and Instagram’s in-app browsers a direct URL loaded while any in-app navigation or Buy Now left a white screen. The URL changed, and locking then unlocking the phone revealed the destination—content had loaded but never painted. Root cause: @view-transition { navigation: auto; } in base.css. Meta’s WebView starts the cross-document transition and never finishes it.
fails.fixZh: 把 Horizon 家族主题升级到 4.11+（官方已加入类似兼容代码）；或在 theme.liquid 检测 FBAN|FBAV|Instagram 给 html 加上 meta-iab 类，并把 @view-transition 包进 html:not(.meta-iab)。上线前必须在 Facebook/Instagram 应用内点测导航与立即购买，不要只在系统浏览器里验收。
fails.fixEn: Upgrade Horizon-family themes to 4.11+ (Shopify added similar compatibility code); or detect FBAN|FBAV|Instagram in theme.liquid, add a meta-iab class on html, and wrap @view-transition in html:not(.meta-iab). QA navigation and Buy Now inside the Facebook/Instagram apps—system Chrome/Safari alone will miss it.

fails.titleZh: Payments 已恢复，结账仍显示「待服务商处理」
fails.titleEn: Payments re-enabled, checkout still “Provider Action Required”
fails.failZh: 商家因错过身份验证被关 Shopify Payments，补件并上诉后 Merchant Trust 批准恢复，邮件写「账户已启用 / 销售已恢复 / 资料已核实」，Support 也确认欺诈冻结已解除、与验证无关。但 34 天、15+ 次工单后顾客仍无法结账：后台一边显示可收款，一边写顾客无法结账；Visa/Mastercard/Shop Pay 标「结账不可用」，仪表盘写「Shopify Payments 销售已暂停」。最新回复改口称支付方式为「Provider Action Required」，问题在支付服务商/银行合作方而非 Merchant Trust，且无解决时限；订阅费仍在扣。
fails.failEn: After a missed identity check disabled Shopify Payments, the merchant submitted docs and won an appeal. Merchant Trust re-enabled the account; emails said “account enabled / sales resumed / business details verified,” and Support confirmed fraud holds were gone and verification was no longer the issue. More than 34 days and 15+ tickets later, customers still could not check out: the Payments page showed payouts active but checkout unavailable; Visa, Mastercard and Shop Pay read “Unavailable at checkout,” and the dashboard said Shopify Payments sales were paused. Support then labeled the methods “Provider Action Required,” pointing to a payment-provider/banking partner rather than Merchant Trust, with no resolution timeline—while the Shopify subscription kept billing.
fails.fixZh: 恢复邮件不等于结账已通：用测试单确认 Visa/Mastercard/Shop Pay 按钮可用。若出现「Provider Action Required」，书面要求升级到支付服务商/银行侧并记下工单号与时间线；立刻启用备用网关（PayPal/Stripe 等）恢复收款；订阅费与停售重叠期保留证据以便交涉。
fails.fixEn: A re-enable email is not a live checkout—place a test order and confirm Visa/Mastercard/Shop Pay buttons work. If methods show “Provider Action Required,” escalate in writing to the payments-provider/banking side and keep ticket IDs plus a timeline; stand up a backup gateway (PayPal/Stripe, etc.) immediately; keep records of subscription fees billed while sales were paused.

fails.titleZh: 机器人绕过自有 Cloudflare 打 myshopify 子域
fails.titleEn: Bots bypass your Cloudflare via myshopify subdomain
fails.failZh: 代理店遭 500+/小时假加购；已上 hCaptcha、行为风控 App、自有 Cloudflare Challenge 限速与国家/ASN 封锁仍无效。日志显示机器人直打 Shopify 托管的 *.myshopify.com（或 shops.myshopify.com 路由子域），自有 CF WAF/限速完全摸不到；Support 称无法在该子域代拦。
fails.failEn: Agency client hit 500+/hr fake add-to-carts. hCaptcha, behavior bot apps, Cloudflare Challenge rate-limits and country/ASN blocks still failed—logs showed bots hitting Shopify-managed *.myshopify.com (not the custom domain), so merchant CF WAF never saw them. Support offered no backend block on that subdomain.
fails.fixZh: Settings→Checkout 临时强制登录结账压假车；DNS 用代理 CNAME 到 shops.myshopify.com（勿裸 A 记录）；监控/告警把 *.myshopify.com 流量算进去，勿只看主域。
fails.fixEn: Temporarily require customer accounts at checkout to blunt fake carts; proxy custom DNS as CNAME→shops.myshopify.com (not a bare A); alert on *.myshopify.com traffic too—custom-domain CF alone is not enough.

fails.titleZh: 垃圾邮件淹没后开 Shop 信贷盗刷数万
fails.titleEn: Spam bomb hid Shop Credit fraud for $25k+
fails.failZh: 一夜涌入上千封无关订阅把收件箱淹没；翻到深处才见 recovery code 登录、欢迎开通 Shopify Credit、信贷披露。攻击者已开约 $30k 额度并刷约 $25k 假批发单到丢弃地址。店主用 Authenticator 2FA 仍中招；Support 称调查可长达 90 天且账户因「可疑」被冻，真单也无法出。
fails.failEn: Thousands of junk signups buried the inbox overnight. Deep in the flood: recovery-code login, Shopify Credit welcome, and disclosure emails. Attackers opened ~$30k credit and charged ~$25k fake wholesale to drop addresses—despite authenticator 2FA. Support cited up to ~90-day investigation while freezing the store for “suspicious activity.”
fails.fixZh: 垃圾邮件潮立刻搜 Shopify/recovery/Credit；关全部会话、换密、硬件密钥优先；同步冻个人征信并银行侧争议；截图时间线与垃圾洪峰作证据，勿干等 Support。
fails.fixEn: On a spam flood, search immediately for Shopify/recovery/Credit; revoke sessions, rotate passwords, prefer hardware keys; freeze personal credit + dispute with banks; screenshot timelines—don’t wait on Support alone.

fails.titleZh: 达「拒付<1%·30天」仍不解冻保证金
fails.titleEn: Met <1% CB for 30 days—reserve still stuck
fails.failZh: 卡测攻击后 Shopify Payments 加 30% 保证金，邮件写拒付率连续 30 天低于 1% 可提前释放。商家修风控并达标后多轮顾问确认「已满足条件、已交 Credit Risk」，却数周无解冻、无拒信、无补件要求，保证金滚到近 $10k，另背约 $4k 债务。
fails.failEn: After a carding spike Shopify Payments put a 30% reserve, emailing early release if CB stayed under 1% for 30 straight days. Merchant fixed fraud, hit the bar, and advisors repeated “requirements met / with Credit Risk”—yet weeks later no release, denial, or doc request while the reserve grew near $10k (~$4k debt carried).
fails.fixZh: 勿单押 SP：备第二网关与现金缓冲；达标后书面催 Underwriting 并保留工单；可考虑 CFPB 等外部投诉通道；现金流按数月锁定期规划。
fails.fixEn: Don’t single-home on SP—stand up a backup gateway and cash buffer; after meeting terms, escalate Underwriting in writing and keep ticket IDs; consider external complaints (e.g. CFPB); cash-plan for multi-month locks.

fails.titleZh: 离店确认拦合法外链
fails.titleEn: Leave-store prompt hits legit outbound links
fails.failZh: 2026-10-20 起 Shopify 对站外跳转加防护（10-23 收窄为恶意拦截/可疑确认）。自有未绑定域名、融资/预约/第二店铺等合法外链仍可能弹「确定离开？」或被拦，且后台无法关闭或加白名单；结账旁异常域名更可怕。
fails.failEn: From 2026-10-20 Shopify added leave-store protection (narrowed 10-23 to block malicious / confirm suspicious). Owned-but-unconnected domains and legit financing/booking/second-storefront links can still prompt or block—no merchant off-switch or allowlist. Unexpected domains next to checkout are worse.
fails.fixZh: Settings→Domains 绑定自有域；手机无痕点测导航/页脚/融资按钮并记录域名；结账或加购出现陌生域先查 App/主题再报 Support（页路径+截图）；勿用主题脚本强行隐藏提示。
fails.fixEn: Connect owned domains under Settings→Domains; phone-test menus/footer/financing CTAs and log domains; if Add to cart/Checkout names an unknown host, audit apps/theme then file Support with path+screenshot—don’t hack the prompt away in theme JS.

fails.titleZh: Thank You 附加脚本停后 Meta 少报购
fails.titleEn: Thank You scripts died—Meta under-counts purchases
fails.failZh: 2026-08-26 非 Plus 店 Thank You/订单状态页 Additional Scripts 失效后，多店 Shopify 订单正常但 Meta 购买偏少；原挂在收据页的浏览器像素/部分 CAPI 静默停火，智能出价先按残缺转化砍量。
fails.failEn: After the 2026-08-26 non-Plus Thank You/Order Status Additional Scripts cutoff, several stores kept normal Shopify orders while Meta purchases dipped. Browser pixels (and some CAPI paths) that lived on the old receipt page went quiet—Smart Bidding scales down on partial conversion signal.
fails.fixZh: 把购买事件迁到 Settings→Customer events（官方 Meta/Google 渠道或自定义像素订阅 checkout_completed）；Events Manager 对比 8/26 前后 browser vs server；测一单核对 event_id 去重；放量以店铺实收为准并标注缺口日。
fails.fixEn: Move purchase tags to Settings→Customer events (official Meta/Google channel or custom pixel on checkout_completed); compare browser vs server in Events Manager around Aug 26; place a paid test order and confirm event_id dedupe; scale on Shopify paid orders and annotate the gap days.

fails.titleZh: Markets 预付关税配了不支持承运商
fails.titleEn: Prepaid DDP offered with non-DDP carriers
fails.failZh: 开启 Shopify Markets 结账预付关税（DDP）后，买家仍可选 USPS First Class International（约 $32）并勾预付关税；USPS 实际不支持 DDP 面单。商家买标只能改 DHL DDP（约 $52）再另付约 $22 关税，差额由店承担。
fails.failEn: With Markets prepaid duties on, checkout still let a buyer pick USPS First Class International (~$32) plus prepaid duties—USPS can’t issue DDP labels. At label buy the merchant was forced onto DHL DDP (~$52) plus ~$22 duties/taxes not fully collected at checkout.
fails.fixZh: 开 DDP 的国际分区只保留支持预付关税的承运商（如 DHL Express 等官方名单）；去掉 USPS 等不兼容选项；用测试结账核对买家运费与可买面单一致后再放量。
fails.fixEn: In DDP-enabled international zones keep only carriers Shopify can buy DDP labels for (e.g. DHL Express per Help docs); remove USPS/other non-DDP rates; test-checkout until quoted shipping matches a buyable DDP label before scaling.

fails.titleZh: Meta 默认开「设备端转化」虚高 ROAS
fails.titleEn: Meta on-device conversions inflate reported ROAS
fails.failZh: 2026-11-12 起「Measure conversions on customer devices」对合格 Pixel 默认开启；Ads Manager 购买数可上涨而 Shopify 实收不变，大促前易误判放量。
fails.failEn: From 2026-11-12 “Measure conversions on customer devices” defaults on for eligible Pixels. Ads Manager purchases can rise while Shopify paid orders stay flat—easy to over-scale into BFCM.
fails.fixZh: Events Manager → Pixel → Settings 核对并按需关闭；导出 Meta 归因购买与 Shopify 已付订单按日对照；放量前以店铺实收为准。
fails.fixEn: Check/opt out per Pixel in Events Manager → Settings; export Meta-attributed purchases vs Shopify paid orders by day; scale only on store revenue, not Ads Manager alone.

fails.titleZh: 拒付率 <1% 仍被关 SP，Q4 货款冻结
fails.titleEn: SP disabled at <1% CB—Q4 funds frozen
fails.failZh: Plus 店 10 月约 $115K、仪表盘拒付 0.59%，仍以「financial risk」给 3 天通知关闭 Shopify Payments，并冻约 $35,765 至 2027-03；另有伙伴店 30 天约 $130K、0.58% 被关。卡支付临黑五断流。
fails.failEn: Plus store ~$115K in Oct at 0.59% CB got a 3-day “financial risk” SP disable and ~$35,765 held until 2027-03; another partner store (~$130K/30d, 0.58% CB) hit the same. Card checkout dies right before BFCM.
fails.fixZh: 勿单押 Shopify Payments：备第二收款通道并提前测通；留供应商发票/物流轨迹备申诉；现金流按最长冻结期（可达数月）预留。
fails.fixEn: Don’t single-home on Shopify Payments—stand up and test a backup gateway; archive invoices/tracking for appeals; cash-plan for multi-month holds.

fails.titleZh: App 配置 API 注入假结账劫持刷卡
fails.titleEn: App config API injected fake-checkout skimmer
fails.failZh: 2026-10-10 起 Hulk Product Options（及 Swym/Selleasy 等同型）从厂商配置 API 的 custom_js 下发恶意脚本；点 Checkout 先跳假页盗卡再回真结账，订单仍成功故后台难察觉。同会话只跳一次，复测常「正常」。
fails.failEn: From 2026-10-10 Hulk Product Options (and Swym/Selleasy peers) served malware via vendor config custom_js. Checkout click → fake page steals card → real checkout; orders still succeed so admin looks fine. Once-per-session flag makes retests look clean.
fails.fixZh: 无痕窗口多次点结账，确认地址栏仍在自有域；查 sessionStorage 是否有 __ctf_ 键；清空各 App「自定义 JS/HTML」；关停可疑 App Embed 并轮换密码/开 2FA。
fails.fixEn: Retest Checkout in fresh private windows—stay on your domain; look for __ctf_ sessionStorage keys; purge custom JS/HTML in app settings; disable suspicious embeds; rotate passwords + enable 2FA.

fails.titleZh: 风控未标高风险，自动履约亏光货款
fails.titleEn: Fraud unmarked + auto-fulfill → $3K loss
fails.failZh: 开启自动处理且依赖「高风险不处理」；同一地址、不同姓名邮箱连下同款 10 件，Shopify 全标正常。代发已履约后遭拒付全败，欠平台约 $3,013。
fails.failEn: Auto-process with “skip high-risk” on; flood of 10× same SKU to one Miami address under different names/emails—all marked fine. Dropship fulfilled; every chargeback lost; owed ~$3,013.
fails.fixZh: 关掉自动履约；对同址多单/重复 SKU 人工审核；叠加 3DS 与第三方风控，勿只信平台欺诈分。
fails.fixEn: Disable auto-fulfill; manually hold same-address / repeat-SKU bursts; add 3DS + a fraud tool beyond Shopify’s score alone.

fails.titleZh: 新店应买家取消一单，触发 10% 滚动保证金
fails.titleEn: One customer cancel → 10% reserve for 120 days
fails.failZh: 开店约 30 天、0 拒付、约 115 单；应买家请求取消未发货订单后 24h 内打款被冻。补齐发票与库存照后仍被加 10% 保证金 120 天，Q4 预估锁约 $50k。
fails.failEn: 30-day store, 0 chargebacks, ~115 orders; refunded one unfulfilled cancel at buyer request. Within 24h payouts held; after docs, 10% reserve for 120 days (~$50k locked through Q4).
fails.fixZh: 新主体备足现金流与备用收款通道；保留供应商发票/库存照；高风险标单勿轻易履约。
fails.fixEn: Keep cash buffer + backup gateway for new entities; archive supplier invoices/inventory photos; don’t fulfill high-risk-flagged orders lightly.

fails.titleZh: Developer Preview 误导「可保留 2 年」致店铺不可恢复
fails.titleEn: Dev Preview UI said 2-year restore—store gone
fails.failZh: Partner Developer Preview 建好准上线店后取消；后台写「信息保留 2 年可联系恢复」。多轮客服后承认文案错误且 Preview 店无法恢复，资产与 $500+ 成本归零。
fails.failEn: Built a production-ready Partner Developer Preview store, then cancelled. Admin said data kept 2 years for reactivation; after days of support, admitted the UI was wrong—Preview stores unrestorable; $500+ assets lost.
fails.fixZh: Preview 当易失环境；关键主题/素材/目录独立备份导出；切付费计划前先导出，勿信后台保留承诺。
fails.fixEn: Treat Preview as volatile; back up themes/assets/catalogs off-platform; export before plan switches—don’t trust the 2-year UI copy.

fails.titleZh: 迁站后旧 Shopify 链接全是 404
fails.titleEn: Legacy Shopify URLs still 404 after migration
fails.failZh: 旧 Shopify/Etsy 链接在广告与社媒仍被点击，155 条路径进 404；GA 显示 0 购买，实际 Stripe 有约 $249 成单，广告在优化空信号。
fails.failEn: Old Shopify/Etsy links still drew clicks—155 paths hit 404. GA showed 0 purchases while Stripe logged a ~$249 order; ads optimized on empty signals.
fails.fixZh: 做完整 301 重定向图并保留路径转发；核对购买事件与支付后台一致后再放大广告。
fails.fixEn: Ship a full 301 redirect map (preserve path at the registrar); reconcile purchase events vs the payment dashboard before scaling ads.

fails.titleZh: Script Tag 冻结后重装 App 静默丢追踪
fails.titleEn: Script Tag freeze: reinstall silently kills tracking
fails.failZh: 2026-10-01 起无法新建/更新 Script Tag；重装仍靠 Script Tag 的 App 后像素不回写，店面看似正常，广告侧转化归零。
fails.failEn: Since 2026-10-01 Shopify blocks creating/updating Script Tags. Reinstalling a script-tag app looks fine but events never return—tracking dies silently.
fails.fixZh: 审计 scriptTags；迁到 Web Pixels / Theme App Embed；大促前勿重装未迁移的追踪 App。
fails.fixEn: Audit scriptTags; migrate to Web Pixels / theme app embeds; do not reinstall unmigrated tracking apps before peak sales.

fails.titleZh: 加购 App 被注入脚本劫持结账跳转
fails.titleEn: Upsell app script injected → checkout redirect
fails.failZh: 2026-10-13 Selleasy 遭外部攻击，恶意脚本注入店面，部分买家结账被重定向到外部站。
fails.failEn: On 2026-10-13 Selleasy was attacked; a malicious script redirected some shoppers away at checkout.
fails.fixZh: 异常跳转立刻关闭 App Embed；核查结账仍在自有域名；优先选用可快速关停注入的 App，并跟进官方清理通知。
fails.fixEn: Disable the app embed on odd redirects; verify checkout stays on your domain; prefer apps whose inject path can be killed fast; follow vendor cleanup notices.

fails.titleZh: 强制注册导致结账跳出
fails.titleEn: Forced account creation kills checkout
fails.failZh: 结账必须先注册，移动端跳出率飙升。
fails.failEn: Checkout required signup first; mobile bounce spiked.
fails.fixZh: 开启访客结账；注册放到下单后。
fails.fixEn: Enable guest checkout; defer signup until after purchase.

fails.titleZh: 运费在最后一步才显示
fails.titleEn: Shipping cost revealed too late
fails.failZh: 商品页写 Free shipping，结账突然加 $12。
fails.failEn: PDP said free shipping; checkout added $12.
fails.fixZh: 在购物车/商品页预估运费；门槛写清楚。
fails.fixEn: Show shipping estimator on cart/PDP; clarify thresholds.

fails.titleZh: Pixel 双重触发导致优化跑偏
fails.titleEn: Duplicate Pixel events skew optimization
fails.failZh: 主题 + App 各打一次 Purchase，ROAS 虚高后突然掉。
fails.failEn: Theme + app both fired Purchase; ROAS looked great then crashed.
fails.fixZh: 只留一条标准事件链路；用 Pixel Helper 验一次。
fails.fixEn: Keep one event path; verify with Pixel Helper.

fails.titleZh: Broad 投放但素材只有一张主图
fails.titleEn: Broad targeting with a single static creative
fails.failZh: 学习期烧完预算，CTR < 0.6%。
fails.failEn: Learning budget burned; CTR under 0.6%.
fails.fixZh: 先做 3–5 条短视频/UGC 测款，再放大。
fails.fixEn: Test 3–5 short video/UGC creatives before scaling.

fails.titleZh: 运费区与物流商覆盖不一致
fails.titleEn: Shipping zones don't match carrier coverage
fails.failZh: 阿拉斯加/夏威夷下单成功，实际无法发货。
fails.failEn: AK/HI orders accepted but not shippable.
fails.fixZh: 按承运商可达区配置 zone；不可达州禁用。
fails.fixEn: Align zones with carrier reach; block unreachable regions.

fails.titleZh: 跨境小包缺 HS Code 被扣关
fails.titleEn: Missing HS codes cause customs holds
fails.failZh: 商业发票品名写 gift，多次查验延误。
fails.failEn: Invoices said “gift”; repeated customs delays.
fails.fixZh: SKU 维护英文品名 + HS；禁写 gift/sample。
fails.fixEn: Maintain EN description + HS per SKU; never gift/sample.

fails.titleZh: 新店 PayPal 大额被冻结
fails.titleEn: New-store PayPal holds on large orders
fails.failZh: 首周大单后余额限制，发货资金断裂。
fails.failEn: Early large order triggered hold; cash for fulfillment froze.
fails.fixZh: 提升店铺信息完整度；大单先用卡支付分流；备第二收款通道。
fails.fixEn: Complete business profile; route big orders to cards; add backup payout.

fails.titleZh: 多币种显示与结算币种混乱
fails.titleEn: Display currency vs settlement mismatch
fails.failZh: 前台 EUR，后台仍 USD 结算，对账痛苦。
fails.failEn: Storefront EUR but settlement USD; reconciliation hell.
fails.fixZh: 明确 presentment vs settlement；报表按结算币汇总。
fails.fixEn: Clarify presentment vs settlement; report in settlement FX.

fails.titleZh: 装了 20+ App 首页 5 秒+
fails.titleEn: 20+ apps make homepage 5s+
fails.failZh: 弹窗、评价、像素、推荐全开，LCP 崩。
fails.failEn: Popups, reviews, pixels, upsells — LCP collapsed.
fails.fixZh: 审计 App；非关键延迟加载；合并像素。
fails.fixEn: Audit apps; defer non-critical; consolidate pixels.

fails.titleZh: App 改 Liquid 导致升级翻车
fails.titleEn: App Liquid edits break theme upgrade
fails.failZh: 一键升级主题后加购按钮消失。
fails.failEn: Theme upgrade removed ATC button.
fails.fixZh: 改动走 Theme App Extension；升级前预览副本。
fails.fixEn: Prefer Theme App Extensions; preview a copy before upgrade.

fails.titleZh: SEA COD 拒收率未计入 ROI
fails.titleEn: SEA COD rejection ignored in ROI
fails.failZh: 广告按 COD 下单量优化，实际签收仅 55%。
fails.failEn: Ads optimized on COD orders; delivery success only 55%.
fails.fixZh: 用签收/回款做核心指标；高风险地区预付优先。
fails.fixEn: Optimize on delivered/paid; prefer prepaid in high-risk areas.

fails.titleZh: 落地页跳转丢掉 UTM
fails.titleEn: Landing redirect strips UTMs
fails.failZh: 短链/应用跳转后 GA4 全变 direct。
fails.failEn: After short-link redirects, GA4 showed all direct.
fails.fixZh: 保留 query；用服务器或主题确保 UTM 透传。
fails.fixEn: Preserve query strings; ensure UTM passthrough in theme/server.

fails.titleZh: 退货政策与实际尾程冲突
fails.titleEn: Return policy clashes with last-mile reality
fails.failZh: 承诺 30 天免费退，跨境退件成本高于客单。
fails.failEn: Promised free 30-day returns; reverse logistics > AOV.
fails.fixZh: 跨境写清买家承担退运或本地退货仓。
fails.fixEn: State buyer-paid returns or local return hub for cross-border.

fails.titleZh: 未开 3DS 欧洲拒付飙升
fails.titleEn: No 3DS → EU chargeback spike
fails.failZh: PSD2 相关争议增多，利润被吞。
fails.failEn: PSD2-related disputes rose; margin eaten.
fails.fixZh: 对欧区开启 3DS/SCA；高风险交易加强验证。
fails.fixEn: Enable 3DS/SCA for EU; step-up high-risk txs.

fails.titleZh: 试用 App 到期自动扣费
fails.titleEn: Trial apps auto-charge unnoticed
fails.failZh: 月底账单多出 $200+ 无感知订阅。
fails.failEn: Month-end bill +$200 from forgotten trials.
fails.fixZh: 日历提醒试用结束；不用即卸；季度清一次账单。
fails.fixEn: Calendar trial ends; uninstall unused; quarterly bill audit.
